key_points: FTC granted early approval for Adobe’s acquisition of Topaz Labs, boosting AI creative capabilities.
Morgan Stanley downgraded ADBE citing cleaner growth and AI monetization elsewhere, pressuring the stock.
Adobe retains approximately $24.5 billion for share buybacks, about a quarter of its market cap.
GuruFocus DCF model estimates intrinsic value around $520, suggesting the stock may be undervalued.
Analyst views are mixed: some see 31% upside while others question downside after a recent 32% drop.
